content: coffee A controlled explosion on a film set near the O2 arena in London ignited a fire that destroyed a van and damaged a car and lorry. Firefighters were summoned to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday, and after about an hour the blaze was brought under control by roughly twenty‑five crews, with no injuries reported. The incident followed a pre‑planned filming activity close to the venue that will host concerts by Niall Horan and Texas later in the week. The London Fire Brigade posted on X that the fire in the Silvertown yard is now under control, noting that one vehicle was lost and most of a car and lorry suffered damage, while no injuries have been reported. They added that the fire stemmed from a controlled explosion on the set that spread beyond expectations, and that crews will stay on site for the rest of the evening. The yard is also situated near the Thames cable‑car link, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
